items.title: Les Arènes Lyriques and Lee Miller guided visits
items.summary: Open-air orchestral concerts in Montmartre through 15 August and adult visit-conferences at the Musée d'Art Moderne on 28 and 30 July.

items.title: SM4RT structured motion geometry and dRAE hyper-spherical quantization
items.summary: SM4RT decomposes dynamic scenes into shared SE(3) motion bases with per-pixel assignments; dRAE routes discrete visual codes by angular geometry to avoid magnitude-driven codebook collapse.

items.title: XOR and binary-fuse filters
items.summary: Static approximate-membership filters encode key fingerprints across three hash-selected positions using a peeled sparse hypergraph, yielding three-read XOR queries with low space overhead.

items.title: Mica surface reconstruction for unidirectional 2D oxide epitaxy
items.summary: Reconstructing mica's surface oxygen plane selects a common orientation for centimetre-scale single-crystalline 2D metal-oxide films, including Fe-doped CoO with reported Curie temperature up to 430 K.

items.title: Correlated European wildfire capacity and Freyja's modular procurement model
items.summary: France and Spain face simultaneous mass evacuations and scarce shared firefighting assets; Ukraine's proposed Freyja interceptor tests whether European defence procurement can sustain genuinely open interfaces.

items.title: A Freyja MVP is a programme milestone, not an operational shield
items.summary: A prototype would demonstrate subsystem integration, but operational anti-ballistic capability also requires adversarial testing, production, trained crews, interceptor stocks and rules-of-engagement integration.

items.title: Luxemburg on militarism as a province of accumulation
items.summary: Luxemburg argues that taxation concentrates dispersed purchasing power into regular state demand for armaments, while the commentary qualifies the autonomy of military demand and emphasizes institutional lock-in.

items.title: Arendt on violence versus power; Ibn Khaldun on taxation and dynastic decay
items.summary: Arendt distinguishes collective authorization from instrumental violence; Ibn Khaldun embeds falling revenue under higher assessments in a wider account of administrative expansion and declining group solidarity.

items.title: avoir beau + infinitif
items.summary: A common concessive construction meaning no matter how much or even though, often emphasizing an unsuccessful effort; the following verb remains infinitive.

items.title: Venetian wellheads concealed rainwater filtration cisterns
items.summary: Rainwater flowed from roofs and campi through sand into clay-sealed cisterns protected from brackish lagoon water; parish officials rationed access and Brenta-water carriers supplemented supply.

items.title: Kavka's toxin puzzle
items.summary: A reward depends on sincerely intending a future harmful action even though, once the reward is secured, performing that action has no instrumental benefit.
